[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Rotate Array** [LC 189 · Rotate Array](https://leetcode.com/problems/rotate-array/){difficulty="Medium"}

Right-rotate by $k$ means the last $k$ elements jump to the front. Reversing the whole array flips the blocks into the right *order* but leaves each block itself reversed; reversing the two blocks fixes them. Three reversals, $O(1)$ space.

[Solved in full in @sec-arr-p3-a.]{.card-link}
